title: MVE observation record (oae-mve-observation-v5)
description: Authoritative schema (docs/mve/ holds a derived copy checked equal). One diagram, one record, five evidence classes. Every node of the dependency graph has an id and a `depends_on`; the graph's nodes are: sources (txt/geo), problem propositions (prm/ndg/goal), entities (ent) and their geometries (geo), obs, mea, der, asm, jud, dec, formal propositions (prop), typecheck (tc), proof (prf), equivalence (eqv), render (rnd). Invalidation is transitive over depends_on; an invalidated node gets valid=false and can no longer be cited. Structural rules live here; referential integrity, uniqueness across arrays, authorisation (MVE_PLAN §4a), stage invariants and canonical-form checks live in mve/record.py. Older schema versions are rejected, not migrated.

deps.description: ids this item was computed from; transitive invalidation follows this field everywhere

predicate.description: Registry v1 (mve/registry/predicates_v1.json) fixes arity, argument kinds/order and degeneracy per predicate. P1 active rows (frozen): Collinear, Concyclic, Parallel, Perpendicular, EqualLength, EqualAngle, Midpoint, SBetween (strict betweenness), RightAngle, plus the nondegeneracy predicates Distinct and NotCollinear. Everything else is registered but inactive until its row is frozen.

exact.description: exact-expression grammar over the REAL ALGEBRAIC numbers (no pi, no transcendental constants): expr := term (('+'|'-') term)* ; term := factor (('*'|'/') factor)* ; factor := INT | 'sqrt(' INT ')' | '(' expr ')' | factor '^' INT | '-' factor . Canonical stored form = the same grammar re-rendered from sympy.nsimplify(parse(expr), rational=True) with sqrt/rational normal form (NOT srepr); the semantic validator requires render(parse(value_exact)) == value_exact and rejects anything else. Angles are in degrees, so 90, 45, 60 are integers; an angle that is not an algebraic number of degrees has value_exact = null and is not an exact truth value.

args.description: entity ids (or binder names inside `problem`) in registry order

depends_on.description: exactly one src id (txt_N or geo_N)

record_id.description: EXECUTION identity: sha256(content_hash + perceiver model + prompt sha + provenance.request_nonce). Same content re-run ⇒ new record_id; lineage kept in `lineage`.

content_hash.description: MATHEMATICAL identity over the canonical projection (mve/record.py canonical_projection, sorted-key JSON, no whitespace): synthetic = {generator.id, generator.version, generator.config_sha256, seed, versions.predicate_registry, generator.evaluator_version, canonical problem, image.truth.candidate_universe_sha256, image.truth.math_coordinates_sha256}; ingested/user = {image.sha256, versions.predicate_registry, canonical problem}. Image bytes are EXCLUDED for synthetic records. Truth EVIDENCE (candidate classes, DDAR outcomes, ddar_version, ddar_budget_s) is NOT in the projection: it lives in the truth artifact whose sha256 is sources[].sha256; changing it is an evidence revision (bump revision, new sources[].sha256), not a new identity. Equal (generator id, version, config, seed, registry, evaluator version) ⇒ equal content_hash. A problem edit, or a truth edit that changes the candidate universe, the mathematical coordinates, the generator inputs or the evaluator version, changes content_hash and creates a new record with lineage.parent_record_id.

stage.description: see MVE_PLAN §4a operations table; measure is permitted from ground_truth (synthetic fixtures, coordinate_consistency on ground_truth geometries) as well as from perceived

measurement_contract.description: null before a fitted contract exists (ground_truth / ingested / perceived stages)

label_set.description: sha256 of the labels.jsonl snapshot the lock was fit on

eval_task.description: which of the three scored tasks this record belongs to; scored apart

isolation.description: what the inference stages may read; ground-truth artifacts are never mounted for A1–A3

math_coordinates_sha256.description: hash of the exact mathematical coordinates (distinct from rendered pixel coordinates; not-to-scale controls differ here)

render_pinned.description: true when the renderer + config are pinned so PNG bytes are deterministic

transform_to_entity_frame.description: affine [a,b,c,d,e,f] mapping OCR frame to entity frame; identity when equal

premises.description: stated givens prm_N; each depends_on one src id

nondegeneracy.description: ndg_N; predicates Distinct / NotCollinear only (semantic validator)

goal.description: null = no goal → assumption record only. The formal goal proposition must equal this one under the binder→entity mapping (semantic validator).

geometries.description: one geometry per evidence source: perceiver call 1, call 2, image measurement, ground truth. Each is addressable (geo_N) so measurements can say which coordinates they used.

params.description: point [x,y]; segment/ray/line [x1,y1,x2,y2]; circle [cx,cy,r]; arc [cx,cy,r,a0,a1]; polygon/curve [x1,y1,...] (≥3 points); crossing [x,y]; strand: polyline [x1,y1,...] with gaps encoded as NaN-free segments list in `pieces`; region: polygon; marks [x,y,w,h]

pieces.description: strand only: visible sub-polylines, gaps preserved as breaks between pieces (over/under evidence)

localization_sigma_px.description: estimated coordinate uncertainty; required for image_measurement

depends_on.description: perceiver_call_k → the obs ids of that call are downstream (empty here); image_measurement → the mea ids that produced it are downstream; ground_truth → [geo_N]

valid.description: false once invalidated transitively (e.g. its truth source was invalidated)
false once invalidated transitively; invalid nodes cannot be cited

depends_on.description: binder link: the prm/ndg/goal ids whose args name this entity's label (may be empty for unnamed entities)
the geo_N ids of the call's own geometries

valid.description: false once invalidated transitively; invalid nodes cannot be cited

depends_on.description: geo_N ids of the coordinates used (so call-1 vs call-2 vs image measurement is explicit) plus obs_N that motivated it

valid.description: false once invalidated transitively; invalid nodes cannot be cited

exact.description: true when validated exactly (rational/algebraic), false when numeric within declared tolerance

depends_on.description: premises used: prm_N, ndg_N, asm_N only (never mea_N)

valid.description: false once invalidated transitively; invalid nodes cannot be cited
false once invalidated transitively; invalid nodes cannot be cited

verdict.description: confirm/reject/not_visible/unsure are evidence only; `adopt` is the sole verdict that leads to an assumption (semantic validator creates asm_N citing the jud); `decline` refuses; `label` answers a catalogue question

valid.description: false once invalidated transitively; invalid nodes cannot be cited

state_sha256.description: hash of the complete serialized model input

valid.description: false once invalidated transitively; invalid nodes cannot be cited

support.description: authorisation (semantic validator): problem_text → depends_on = one prm/ndg id whose proposition EQUALS this one under the binder→entity mapping; assumption → one asm_N with equal proposition; derived → one der_N, outcome proved, target equal; goal_source → role goal, depends_on = [goal_1], proposition equal to problem.goal.proposition. There is no human_confirmed support: a human `confirm` judgment is evidence for an `adopt` judgment, which creates the assumption that authorises.

from_revision.description: optimistic concurrency: an edit whose from_revision is not the current revision is REJECTED (no merge); the editor rebases and resubmits

patch.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch from from_revision to to_revision; required for kind=edited (replay)

invalidates.description: ids invalidated transitively via depends_on (computed by the semantic validator, including tc/prf/eqv/rnd/prop nodes); each gets valid=false

span.description: text only: char span in the full text

path_hint.description: truth_artifact only: out-of-band location; never mounted for A1–A3

coordinates_exact.description: true only when every point has algebraic coordinates in the exact grammar; a diagram with non-algebraic or unsupported coordinates is NOT a truth source (it may be an unlabelled perception input only)

sources.description: txt_N (problem text spans) and geo_N (truth artifacts). Premises, nondegeneracy and the goal cite one of these via depends_on.
